notes.title: Area 51 Defense - UPDATE #15
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35734904/89114d87b29cb88331b59fce2c75e5a02f14ba9b.png

Hello, soldiers!

It's been a while! We noticed that the last update was in October 2020, and we had already been working on a new update back in November that year. So we are releasing it now:


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35734904/1be99b2539dac080443725732f01a04d434bed17.png

 Level editor visuals updated.
 Editor quality of life updates.
 Added RIGHT CLICK to exit editor item picker.
 New settings added under options menu.
 Helpful bots can now die in combat.
 Player's tank can be destroyed in combat.
 Enemy item drops tweaked.
 Weapon damage changed to min-max range instead of set value every time.
 Tank hit box tweaked to be smaller for better movement.
 Green enemies now run faster with visual cue added.



Happy hunting!


-Harri J.

notes.title: Area 51 Defense - UPDATE #14
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35734904/44629ad898886bccdb9f549183bf0c5c4ec76b8d.png

Hello, soldiers!

We have a long-awaited update for the game, fixing the compatibility issues and adding new improvements to the gameplay. We have especially tackled the reported issue of antivirus software falsely tagging our game as a trojan or malware. These problems should now be fixed. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35734904/1be99b2539dac080443725732f01a04d434bed17.png

 Fixed online high score bug.
 Only player kills now add to the score, instead of having score increased from all the turret and AI soldier kills.
 Level editor has received a massive overhaul.
 All new maps for the Survival game mode.
 Additional Gauntlet Maps added, which you can replace the existing survival maps with. 
 Updated level tiles in the editor, and heaps of new tiles added. 
 Interior levels added into the editor and into playable maps.
 Highlighted hits for the explosive barrels when they get shot.
 Added lights on the pickups, so now they can be seen better in the dark.
 Lighting system in the editor received a big update.
 Fellow AI bots have received an update, and they now move around more. 
 Fixed a lot of software compatibility issues. 


We hope that you will explore the level editor, make new maps and share them with your friends and other community members. Remember to save a safe copy of the existing maps when you edit them!

Happy hunting!


-Harri J.

notes.title: Area 51 Defense - UPDATE #13
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35734904/52ab0b6617671405868c1ef158ea7d538ce9b28c.png


Hello, soldiers! 

This week we have a significant new update, with both visual and gameplay tweaks. One of the biggest updates include adding tank vehicles, fellow soldiers and automatic turrets into the mix. Many elements of the user interface have also gotten a face lift and the main menu has been completely re-hauled. 

Here is the full-ish fixlist of this major update:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35734904/1be99b2539dac080443725732f01a04d434bed17.png

 A whole new look for the main menu.
 Weapons indicator tweaked.
 Added Tank vehicle for the player.
 Added fellow AI soldiers to aid you in battle.
 Added automatic turrets into the game.
 Re-hauled the first map in Survival mode.
 Re-done all weapon projectiles and effect.
 Added enemy death animation bounce in direction of death effect.
 Fixes for the Z ordering loop, tackling the clipping on tall buildings.
 Added gibbing effects for the enemies.
 Added Tank Health and Ammo on HUD and Weapon indicator.
 Added Tank running over enemies, gibbing them.
 Added Tank taking damage from attacking enemies.
 Added game time counters to track time of play in Survival mode.
 Made username to be highlighted if its empty or blank.
 Added basic rank system for the player with names and icons.
 Lighting fix to make day brighter and night darker
 Most lights in-game are now bigger.
 Added a link to Twitter from Credits sub-menu.
 All the fences now have individual damaged graphics and debris when they get destroyed. 
 Added defense turrets without ammo/health limit, so you can place as many in-game as you want.
 Made weapon reload times 20% quicker to balance the new faster enemy speeds.
 Changed enemy spawn times in survival mode from 50 ms to 30 ms
 Max enemies capped at 50, instead of 40.
 Added brightness slider and screen effect in the Options.


New Gameplay Tip:
One new rank takes 3000 kills to level up. Use the base's new defenses to your advantage.


We hope you all enjoy these improvements, because we here at GameRealmMadness and over at Alien Seed Games have worked hard to implement them. Happy hunting! 


- Harri J.

notes.title: Area 51 Defense - Update #12
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35734904/565f66bfd5528a2787dd7f95fe2b6d468b07ba06.png

Hello, soldiers! 

Today we have a patch which features lots of gameplay and quality of life improvements. Ben Hull of Alien Seed Games has worked hard with the programming side, and we've been listening to player feedback. Here is the fixlist: 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35734904/1be99b2539dac080443725732f01a04d434bed17.png

  Changed player speed, both running and walking

  Re-done player leg sprites, spent time re-doing legs so that it looks good in every frame and from every direction

  Added new Z ordering loop for AI graphics, still work in progress and to be improved in upcoming versions 

 Lots of small tweaks into the menu graphics

 Added a new main menu background 

 The game now spawns two large mobs per one wave 

 Changed bullet speeds from the original

 Added new bullet trail effects 

 Changed enemy running speeds to be more challenging

 Tweaked the ammo counter UI, bringing more clarity into it

 Made player turning instant for more direct control 

 Reduced AI jittering and shaking, they now also turn slower 

 Fixed item pickup icons

 Added hi-score uploading after each wave is completed 

 No pickups and powerups achievement now fixed 

 Cursor now rotates with the move of the mouse 


And in addition to these, we've done tons of small tweaks all over! Go give the game a spin, and see for yourself! 

We have lots of new features planned for the game, and we will be adding them in the coming weeks to keep the game alive. Our goal is to support our games after launch and keep on adding fun into them. 

-Harri J.

notes.title: Area 51 Defense - UPDATE #11
notes.notes:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35734904/1be99b2539dac080443725732f01a04d434bed17.png

Have a fun weekend you all and enjoy these new additions! 



- Harri J.

notes.title: Area 51 Defense - Update #9
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35734904/9496725aa6e6682e690e37ef3aed5d172a2e48c9.png


Hello soldiers! It has come time to move out of Early access, as we have now finished most of the features that we had in mind for the game. The year 2019 also is coming to a close, and Christmas is at the doorstep, and we promised full version out by this year's end. 

We will still be updating and supporting the game with new features, if there is demand for it. After the holidays we are focusing our energy on new projects.

 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35734904/1be99b2539dac080443725732f01a04d434bed17.png
 All new Survival maps added. 
 Added a level selection menu to the main menu. 
 Fix for some of the weapon effects. 
 Missing Steam Achievements added. 
 Fixed some of the achievements that were not working correctly. 
 A minor fix for the level editor interface.  



Go and give the game a spin! If you have only tried the first early access versions, you will be surprised by the progress, we're sure :) 


Merry Christmas and Happy New Year, 
from all the people at GameRealmMadness!



- Harri J.

notes.title: Area 51 Defense - UPDATE #7
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35734904/3d53084db68c77bf40534d98e821541d5383ca83.png

Hello soldiers! 

It's been a long wait, and we are finally rolling out the completely re-built version of Area 51 Defense on Steam. 

There's heaps of new features, such as whole new arsenal of weapons, new map, and an in-built map editor. The editor is still in an experimental stage, so bugs are to be expected. We can't wait to hear some community feedback on these all new and shiny things in the game. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35734904/1be99b2539dac080443725732f01a04d434bed17.png
 Completely rebuilt game from the ground up.
 Added eight new weapons. 
 New and improved enemy AI.
 Fresh special effects. 
 In-built level editor. 
 All new power-ups.  


We have also completely updated the look of the game on Steam store and on the library. Hope you all enjoy the fresh visuals! 

- Harri J.

notes.title: GooglePlay version released!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35734904/4108fd513741e197f50d219c6d0e6fcd8289355b.png

Howdy! We have finally released 'Area 51 Defense' on GooglePlay store!

The game has ads as a monetization model, but that means it's completely free to download and play. We have tried to make the game as enjoyable as possible on the mobile platform, but also had to make a few cuts to the features. We feel that the mobile version still does retain the feeling and core gameplay of the PC version, and that it's enjoyable on its own. 

So go ahead and give the Android version a spin and tell us what you think about it!

> Area 51 Defense on GooglePlay


- Harri J.

notes.notes:

notes.title: Area 51 Defense - UPDATE #2
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35734904/7a1b7f0a16a2a601c95ca5fdbaa938e01a555f4c.png
Hello there! 

Another week down and here is the newest update. Today is the day that people are raiding or tryin to raid Area 51. So go join the fight and play our game! 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35734904/bf95e2a9f3c5951a42f11ebe690c0a85e73a37b6.png

 Extra fast dweeb variety added.
 A fix for the Day/Night cycle.
 Missile power-up added. 
 Screenshake adjusted because of community feedback.
 Main menu volume can be adjusted by dragging the mouse.
 Random item placement adjusted.
 Minor fixes for the game UI. 



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35734904/f7a2b0b848f6bc9b39852a929636863901489533.png

Missile power-up can be picked from Wave 3 forward, and the faster dweebs appear from Wave 4 onward. Remember: A wise player will use as much power-ups as they can, but a special achievement awaits those who can play the game without any help.

That's it for this week, stay tuned for more! And as always, leave your suggestions for future updates and features into our Steam Community!

- Harri J.

notes.title: Area 51 Defense - UPDATE 1
notes.notes:
Hello there! 

We have just released the first update for our new game. It has few smaller fixes, while we work on adding bigger stuff. 

Here's the fixlist: 


 Projectiles thrown by the dweebs now stop after a certain time. 
 Objects thrown by dweebs also stop on obstacles.
 Night wave health nerfed. 
 A fix for the graphical Z-positioning for the enemies.
 Weekend waves health nerfed. 
 Weekend wave now limited to Saturday and Sunday.
 New music tracks for the night wave. 
 Miika Puurunen added in the credits as the third musician. 


Enjoy ! 

If you have feedback or suggestions for the game, don't forget to leave a comment or review for the game.


- Harri J.
